metadata.description: Scenario catalogue for Ionian Airlines agent simulations and evaluations. Fixtures are created by the future scenario runner, not stored as permanent customer records.

scenarios.title: Explain in-cabin cat eligibility and fee
scenarios.initial_customer_message: Can I bring a 7 kg cat in the cabin, and what would it cost?
scenarios.customer_goal: Receive an accurate, concise answer before deciding whether to book.
customer_instructions: Do not volunteer a flight date unless Erling says it is needed.
End the conversation after receiving the fee, combined-weight limit, carrier requirement, and advance-notice rule.
pass_criteria: Uses the pets policy before quoting a fee or eligibility rule.
States the EUR 60 per-direction fee, 8 kg combined limit, carrier requirement, and 48-hour notice requirement.
Does not imply a pet reservation or flight availability has been confirmed.

scenarios.title: Search Santorini options for a stated Gold member
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I am an Ionian Loyalty Gold member. I want to fly from Athens to Santorini on 18 September. What options do I have?
scenarios.customer_goal: Understand available flights and the stated Gold Economy Plus benefit without booking.
customer_instructions: You do not have a loyalty number and are only asking for options.
End after Erling has explained the available flight and the Gold Economy Plus presentation.
pass_criteria: Searches current flight availability rather than inventing a schedule or price.
Retrieves the Ionian Loyalty policy before describing the Gold benefit.
Does not claim the customer status has been verified or create a booking.

scenarios.title: Retrieve booking details including ancillary information
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I want to check my existing booking. What information do you need?
scenarios.customer_goal: Verify the itinerary and any added services on the supplied booking.
customer_instructions: When asked, provide the fixture booking reference and its primary contact email.
Ask whether any baggage or services are already attached to the booking.
End after the booking details are accurately summarised.
pass_criteria: Requests both booking reference and primary contact email before lookup.
Uses the returned booking data rather than guessing itinerary, seat, or services.
Does not disclose the booking before backend verification succeeds.

scenarios.title: Add a 23 kg checked bag after explicit confirmation
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I would like to add one 23 kg checked bag to my booking.
scenarios.customer_goal: Add exactly one 23 kg bag only after the price and action have been clearly confirmed.
customer_instructions: Provide the fixture booking reference and primary contact email when requested.
If Erling states the price and asks for final confirmation, reply exactly: Yes, confirm the 23 kg bag.
End after Erling confirms the added service.
pass_criteria: Verifies the booking before attempting the mutation.
Obtains explicit final confirmation before the ancillary tool call.
Adds one confirmed 23 kg checked bag at the policy-driven EUR 50 price.

scenarios.title: Create one business booking after seat selection and confirmation
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I want to fly from Athens to London on 18 September in Business. Please show me the available seats.
scenarios.customer_goal: Book one available Business seat only after reviewing the exact flight, seat, fare, name, email, and final summary.
customer_instructions: Select one available Business seat when offered.
Provide full name Alex Scenario and alex.scenario@example.com only when requested.
After a complete booking summary, reply exactly: Yes, confirm the booking.
End after a booking reference is returned.
pass_criteria: Uses live flight and seat availability before presenting a bookable option.
Does not call create_booking before unambiguous final confirmation.
Returns one confirmed booking reference and does not duplicate the booking.

scenarios.title: Cancel a verified Business booking after refund explanation
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I need to cancel my booking. Can you help?
scenarios.customer_goal: Understand the voluntary cancellation outcome and cancel only after explicit confirmation.
customer_instructions: Provide the fixture booking reference and primary contact email when requested.
If Erling explains the outcome and asks for final confirmation, reply exactly: Yes, confirm the cancellation.
End after Erling confirms cancellation and states the outcome.
pass_criteria: Verifies the booking and retrieves the voluntary changes/refunds policy before quoting the outcome.
Obtains explicit final confirmation before cancellation.
Returns a cancelled status and the backend-calculated refund or credit outcome.

scenarios.title: Reschedule a verified booking after available alternatives and confirmation
scenarios.initial_customer_message: I need to change my Berlin flight to a later option. Can you help?
scenarios.customer_goal: Move the fixture booking only after selecting an available alternative seat and explicitly confirming any change cost.
customer_instructions: Provide the fixture booking reference and primary contact email when requested.
Choose an available alternative shown by Erling.
After a complete change summary, reply exactly: Yes, confirm the change.
End after the confirmed new flight and seat are returned.
pass_criteria: Verifies the booking and retrieves voluntary-change policy before quoting a change outcome.
Uses current flight and seat availability for the replacement selection.
Obtains explicit final confirmation before the reschedule mutation.
